governing_rule: P2 source structures are discovery evidence only. Each accepted joint configuration below is separately adjudicated from exact item wording, source-parent or instrument context, response topology, and the bounded canary membership. Acceptance authorizes respondent-level co-occurrence compilation only for the listed source-wave items; it does not assert proposition identity, response portability, cross-source equivalence, scoring equivalence, or production completeness.

decisions.rationale: The two items are sequential first- and second-ranked answers to the same national-problem priority task. Their rank positions are identity-bearing and must remain distinct inside one respondent-level ranked configuration.
decisions.authorized_inference: Co-occurrence and ordered rank configuration for these two source-native responses.

decisions.rationale: The two adjacent items form a source-native political-knowledge pair with a shared nominal response contract and distinct institutional targets.
decisions.authorized_inference: Raw joint answer configuration across the two knowledge targets.
forbidden_inferences: correctness scoring without an answer-key authority

decisions.rationale: Both items belong to the same source-native before-versus-now evaluation run and share the evaluation response topology, while asking distinct change propositions.

The four items are exact children of one questionnaire justifiability parent and share the certified 1-never to 10-always response contract. They form a moral-permissibility profile while retaining case-specific propositions.
decisions.authorized_inference: Joint signed response-role profile across the four listed moral cases.

decisions.rationale: This is the previously executable GSS abortion-condition family, narrowed to the six exact variables present in the bounded 2010 fixture and retained as the control implementation.
decisions.authorized_inference: Existing GSS conditional-attitude joint pattern semantics for the listed items.
forbidden_inferences: automatic binding to a single P3 proposition family

decisions.rationale: The three items are target-specific children of the same institution-confidence question battery and share a certified four-point confidence scale.
decisions.authorized_inference: Joint signed confidence profile across the three named institutions.

decisions.rationale: The items are exact children of one source-native q301 parent and share a certified agreement response contract. The authority is for an agreement/disagreement configuration only; the propositions retain distinct targets and temporal meanings.
decisions.authorized_inference: Joint signed response-role profile across the three listed transition-evaluation statements.
forbidden_inferences: item-direction homogenization beyond certified response roles

decisions.rationale: The two target-specific items belong to the same institution-trust module and share the certified four-point trust response contract plus a non-substantive no-opinion category.
decisions.authorized_inference: Joint signed trust profile across army and parliament.
